recommendation_summary: The reply says to keep the existing shared order list and show it at the counter sorted by pickup date, with today's and tomorrow's unprepared orders at the top, and to have staff always work from the top down. It skips the Odoo rollout entirely and leaves cancelling or rescheduling the partner booking to the owner. It offers to set up the sorted view once it knows what the list lives in. Nothing extra is recommended for now. The only open point is what the list is kept in.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need every cake due today prepared before pickup. Payments and stock already reconcile correctly, so nobody has asked for new sales or inventory tracking.
labels.Deleted: Odoo and its sales, inventory and manufacturing modules, plus the implementation partner. They replace systems that already work and don't fix what failed.
labels.Bottleneck: Staff work from the shared list without ordering it by pickup date, so next month's cakes were made before today's.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you told me. I haven't seen the list itself or how staff read it.

note: The reply rejects Odoo by name and recommends only a sorted view of the existing list, putting all four record lines before the recommendation.
